page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-288-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 288 dedicated vCPUs across 144 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The processor includes a 504 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and integer operations. The system is equipped with 2232.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 48 NVMe local SSDs totaling 19031 GB of capacity. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in multi-core processing and memory subsystem throughput. The server achieves top 10% placement in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Passmark CPU scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with cached small-block read speeds reaching 22962.94 GB/sec and uncached large-block read speeds at 1060.25 GB/sec, both ranking in the top 10%. Redis SET operations perform at 390.97 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reaches 242.27 GB/sec.

Despite strong multi-core capabilities, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance falling into the average category. Additionally, while LLM prompt processing is strong across small, medium, and large models, text generation speeds show variance, dropping to the bottom 25% for small models and middle 50% for large models. Given the massive memory capacity, high-density local NVMe storage, and high multi-core compute density, this server is suited for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data compilation, and high-throughput web serving workloads.
